tables.counting_unit: complete mechanism proposal with native initial participants

mechanistic_prediction.qualification: Frozen M-CSA v5 source references: 278 stored records; 192 EXACT strict replay references, 86 DELTA_CONSISTENT references retained for diagnostics. Preferred whole-route view uses observed initial participants; only the 192 EXACT records are preferred primary references. Reconstructed initial components, when flagged, use mechanism-derived preconditions and are not independently observed endpoint inputs. Source transitions are ordered; arrows within a native drawing are one atomic group, not physical chronology. Native splits remain unassigned and development-exposure flags are preserved; replay consistency does not establish benchmark blindness or physical truth. Unsupported fishhooks, radical and covalent-metal cases remain outside the accepted conversion. All source identities, certificates, context and arrows are reference-only metadata, withheld from model inputs.
mechanistic_prediction.split_status: unassigned; no independent evaluation cohort claimed
